snippet.title: Tollway Tycoon - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Tollway Tycoon is a chaotic little management sim about running the least glamorous part of the transport network: a toll plaza on a very cursed stretch of highway.

Keep HQ happy and keep the traffic flowing at all costs!
Juggle disasters ranging from potholes, to zombies, UFO's and asteroids!

Find us on steam at 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3976220/Tollway_Tycoon/

See more at
www.tollwaytycoon.com
